reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 (Amendment 2 applied), when ORD-MAX has more than one argument-1 all arguments must be of one class (alphabetic, numeric or alphanumeric per §1985:IV.4.3.3, where numeric-edited, alphanumeric-edited and group items are class alphanumeric), except that alphabetic and alphanumeric may be mixed; a mixed numeric/nonnumeric list must be refused and every same-class list accepted.

reader.notes: CrossViolation intersects each argument's candidate classes after projecting to the class column and merging alphabetic into alphanumeric, which is exactly the amended 1985 rule; figuratives take their class from the context. All eight refusal shapes are refused and all accept shapes return the right ordinal. Diagnostics cite §2023:15.71.3 at --std 85.
